description.p: An unofficial native GTK4 and libadwaita client for the Filester cloud storage service. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Filester.

ul.li: Browse your folder hierarchy from a sidebar
Stream uploads of files up to 10 GB without loading them into memory
Respect the service rate limit automatically
Keep your API key in the system keyring, never in plain-text files
Open public files in your default apps, with optional automatic cleanup
Select several files and folders at once with Ctrl+click, Shift+click, a selection box or Ctrl+A
Move files and folders with Move to… or by dragging them onto a folder
Deletions and moves show their progress in the Activity panel and can be stopped
Fixed deleting files that are not in a folder, and deleting more than 100 items at once

description.p: The app now appears as "Filester Manager" in the application menu and window, so it is not mistaken for an official Filester app. The command is still filester-app, and settings and the saved API key carry over.

ul.li: Sign in with an API key stored in the system keyring
Folder tree, file grid, uploads with progress, new folder and delete
Optionally open public files in local apps, with automatic cleanup of downloaded copies
